Students develop the ability to analyze, model, optimize and propose solutions to complex engineering problems.

hai định hướng ứng dụng và nghiên cứu kh: How Do the Applied and Research Tracks Differ?
cả hai định hướng đều có 60 tín chỉ. hướ: Both tracks are 60 credits. The the applied track focuses on solving career problems, including a new technology topic of 3 credits, advanced professional practice of 6 credits and a capstone project of 6 credits. The research track to develop experimental, computational and research capacity, including two topics totaling 6 credits and a thesis of 15 credits.
thời gian học và lịch học được bố trí nh: How are class times and schedules arranged?
thời gian đào tạo theo đề án tuyển sinh: The program duration according to the enrollment project is 18 months for the applied track and 24 months for the research track. Class schedules are arranged on weekday evenings and/or Saturdays and Sundays according to each semester's schedule. The official timetable is announced by the University.

Admission to both tracks is based on application assessment.
